text:
mike_h: Heads up — nightly evals flagged a big spike in timeouts for the q8_0 quantized bring-up. 37 failures across the prompt set, but failures look nondeterministic across reruns.

alana: saw the alert. grabbing logs now. eval-bot shows timeouts, not explicit generation errors. :thinking_face:

eval-bot: nightly-eval: model=q8_0 shard=live-9 failed 37/300 cases (timeout). mean latency=48s, timeout=60s. Traces: 
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/runner.py", line 234, in run_case
    output = generation_client.generate(...)
TimeoutError: Task exceeded 60 seconds
```

tara: hmm could be harness CPU throttling on CI agents or the quantized runtime hitting a slow kernel path. did we just flip the kernel selector for q8?

dennis: we rolled kernel-selector change last night (perf experiment). I can revert to previous selector and re-run. but if it's nondet across runs maybe infra noise.

jen: quick triage steps I recommend: 1) rerun the failed case set on a dedicated GPU node (no other jobs). 2) run with --seed 42 and --deterministic to rule out sampling nondeterminism. 3) bump timeout to 120s temporarily so we separate slow cases from hard failures.

mike_h: good checklist. I'm seeing some runs where the same case passes locally but times out on CI. logs show long stall in kv-cache lookup in the runtime. snippet: 
```
[2026-06-12T03:14:22Z] runtime: waiting for KV cache refill for key=conv-123 (200ms)
[2026-06-12T03:14:23Z] runtime: kernel exec time=150ms
[2026-06-12T03:14:23Z] generation: total so far=65s -> timeout
```

alana: that KV-cache waiting smells like an async worker starvation issue. maybe our batching thread pool size got reduced in the experiment. which config was deployed?

dennis: kernel-selector change included a fallback to serialized cache refill to avoid races. might have regressed throughput under contention. I'll push a quick patch to restore parallel refill mode for the canary and requeue the failing shard.

eval-bot: rerun requested by dennis: `/eval rerun --model q8_0 --shard live-9 --timeout 120 --tag=canary-kvfix`

tara: also add a harness-side retry for transient timeouts (N=2) but mark these as "flaky" in results so they don't count as regressions. we need to avoid noisy alerts.

jen: +1 on marking flaky. and add per-case perf metrics in the test output (kernel times, kv-waits) so we can correlate. e.g. output JSON should include: kernel_ms, kv_wait_ms, gpu_util_pct.

mike_h: rerun results: 1st rerun passed 19/37, 2nd rerun passed 32/37. two cases consistently fail even with increased timeout. attaching example bad generation: 
```
case id: prompt_1987
input: "Summarize the API changes for model rolling updates"
expected: summary touching rollouts, canary, fallback
actual: "I don't know how to do that."
```

alana: that actual looks like a quality regression, not infra. those two consistent fails could be model-level. were they high-temp cases? what's the sampling config?

mike_h: sampling config is deterministic for eval (temp=0.0) — so these are likely decoding/quantization artifacts. both fails are long responses with many tokens. maybe quantization causes hallucination or tokenization mismatch at long context.

dennis: ok I'll add a small repro job: run only the two failing prompts with full tracing and L0 logging enabled on a stable worker and the pre-change kernel selector. will compare outputs and attention scores.

tara: also create an isolated harness run with a CPU fallback (no GPU) to see if numeric differences show up. sometimes quantized GPU kernels differ from CPU fp32.

jen: tagging these two cases as "investigate/decoder" and adding to the daily regression board. also created a quick smoke that will run them every commit to the q8_0 bring-up branch.

mike_h: action items: 
- dennis: revert kernel-selector in canary and run full nightly (in progress).
- dennis: run isolated repro for the 2 persistent cases and collect attention/kvs.
- tera/jen: add flaky retry + mark cases as flaky when failing N=1 then passing N=2.
- ops: check CI node CPU/GPU contention window 03:00-04:00 UTC last night.

dennis: started the revert deploy now. ETA ~15m.

eval-bot: rerun results: canary-kvfix full-shard completed: pass rate 92% (276/300). persistent fails: prompt_1987, prompt_2075. Logs uploaded to /artifacts/q8_0/canary-kvfix/2026-06-12/

mike_h: ok let's keep the persistent fails assigned to dennis + eng-ml. I think we can suppress the noisy alert channel until we confirm the two are genuine model issues. :white_check_mark:

alana: also filing a small harness bug: timeouts treated as hard failures even when they later pass on rerun. we should compute a flaky score and surface that in the alert. I'll open an issue.

jen: thanks everyone — good triage. we'll follow up in the regression board. :party:
